thesis: A pristine MNC-pharma compounder priced to perfection. Every engine gate passes — zero pledge, zero debt, Z-score safe, Piotroski clean, Sloan/E2-E6 all PASS, usability gap 0.0% — and the business earns 32-33% ROE with 85% cash conversion and a 90% dividend payout. But the DCF, even with growth capped at 15% (vs a 32.8% uncapped sustainable rate), lands at Rs 26,055 — the stock trades at Rs 26,080. There is nothing to buy here at this price: the anchor ladder demands -19% (ACC) or -39% (INV) before a leg can fill. This is a watchlist compounder, not an entry.
